quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin on his bifurcated coverage of the Sixers and Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I think Brian over at Front Office Sports just got tired of doing that with you every other year

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The subject of a Front Office Sports Q&A, a feature profile Q&A, asking our man Dave McMenamin. Hello Dave, welcome to Friendsgiving.

text_blocks.speaker: Dave McMenamin
text_blocks.text: Hey, what's going on guys? I think Brian over at Front Office Sports just got tired of doing that with you every other year and so he needed the new subject this time.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin on the challenges of covering the Sixers and Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I have been the dinosaur on the staff, still be fortunate enough to kind of cover one team

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: McMenamin has covered multiple teams at once, but not 3,000 miles apart. This is a tough assignment because both of these teams, for a minute, they were both the two top teams in each conference.

text_blocks.speaker: Dave McMenamin
text_blocks.text: I have been the dinosaur on the staff, still be fortunate enough to kind of cover one team, not that that team hasn't certainly run me ragged when it was LeBron with the Lakers. But Tim, old hat at this, being responsible for OKC and Houston and San Antonio and Memphis and Utah all at the same time.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin on the Lakers' 14-3 start and their strength of schedule
quotes.excerpt: for all the people out there who aren't too keen on critical thinking who try to criticize Ramona Shelburne

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Lakers' path, they keep piling up wins, but there are some cracks in the armor you could point to. And the Lakers, similar path, they keep winning basketball games, their offense is historically fantastic, but you look at some of their question marks with their depth and their strength of schedule.

text_blocks.speaker: Dave McMenamin
text_blocks.text: For all the people out there who aren't too keen on critical thinking who try to criticize Ramona Shelburne for pointing out that the Lakers haven't played anybody. Yeah, they are 14 and 3. They haven't played Boston, they haven't played Philadelphia, they haven't played Houston, they haven't played Denver, they haven't played Memphis, they haven't played OKC. It is fair to point out that they haven't played anyone yet. However, all you can do is win the games on your schedule and both Philadelphia and Los Angeles have done really well so far.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Lakers' back-loaded schedule
quotes.excerpt: the Lakers' schedule every year is back-loaded, every year because they back-load the best games
quotes.quote: The Lakers' schedule every year is back-loaded, every year because they back-load the best games for the TV games after football season. This is not a controversial position.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on the Lakers' upcoming road trip
quotes.excerpt: we're about to find out a little something about the Lakers and hopefully Austin Reaves can be back
quotes.quote: We're about to find out a little something about the Lakers and hopefully Austin Reaves can be back by the time they get on this post-Thanksgiving road trip. Last three games of this month, at the Spurs, at the Grizzlies, who look pretty legit, and at the Rockets.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin on the Lakers' upcoming schedule and Austin Reaves' injury
quotes.excerpt: they will not have Austin Reaves against Utah and so it's going to be five straight missed games
quotes.quote: They will not have Austin Reaves against Utah and so it's going to be five straight missed games. The schedule gives them four days without a game leading into that game after Thanksgiving at San Antonio. It is an early season tent-pole, but it is a tent-pole game. You are playing the reigning Western Conference champs. San Antonio has basically been at full strength and no Tobias Harris. They are waiting on him to return from that calf injury, but he will be more of a role player. And Dylan Harper is out now with the groin. You will get an approximation of those two teams playing close to full strength and that's an exciting matchup in that NBA Cup with NBA Cup qualifying implications occurring.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin on Walker Kessler's performance
quotes.excerpt: Walker Kessler came so strong out the gates and I'm going to have a story that drops on Friday
quotes.quote: Walker Kessler came so strong out the gates and I'm going to have a story that drops on Friday about Kessler. He's shown some signs of just being a young player and maybe his body, having not played for nine months, coming to the Lakers, needing to get back into that rhythm and that conditioning and everything that it takes to play four times a week. We'll see how he does in that individual matchup against Victor Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on Rob Pelinka's trade market comments
quotes.excerpt: Rob Pelinka was on Spectrum SportsNet and I'm paraphrasing here but basically said, hey, we're good
quotes.quote: Rob Pelinka was on Spectrum SportsNet and I'm paraphrasing here but basically said, hey, we're good. I need to make some stuff happen in the trade market to get some reinforcements for this team because this roster is good enough to merit that. What do you think he's looking at specifically there?

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin on the Lakers' need for a switchable big man
quotes.excerpt: the roster is missing a dynamic, almost like an active big
quotes.quote: The roster is missing a dynamic, almost like an active big. And this is not to say anything negative about Walker Kessler, he's doing his job quite well, but to have someone who can be a switchable big who can block shots, play with energy, run the floor, play a little bit more above the rim. If Jackson Hayes was 6'10", maybe the guy they had the last couple years, because Jackson quite wasn't switching out to the perimeter as much. That's missing from this roster. Some of the problems they've had the last couple years, shooting, that's addressed. They've basically been top 10 in three-point percentage most of the year.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Lakers' trade assets
quotes.excerpt: they have 8 million dollars that they can spend, almost exactly 8 million, not in free agency obviously
quotes.quote: They have 8 million dollars that they can spend, almost exactly 8 million, not in free agency obviously, but they can take on 8 million dollars in salary because they're hard-capped at the first apron because they got Walker Kessler in a sign-and-trade. They have no tradeable first-round picks. They have three tradeable second-round picks, two of which they got from the Wizards for DeAndre Ayton. When they elected to trade away DeAndre Ayton, they were clearing cap space, that was part of what that maneuver was. I assume they're hoping to maybe use those picks to try to address the spot on the roster.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on Luka Doncic's pass to Kevon Looney
quotes.excerpt: I think the opener, Luka threw a lob to Kevon Looney and Looney just kind of looked up like
quotes.quote: I think the opener, Luka threw a lob to Kevon Looney and Looney just kind of looked up like, what do you think I'm going to do with that?

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin on Kevon Looney's role with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Looney's falling out of the rotation. Actually, he got some minutes when Walker was out
quotes.quote: Looney's falling out of the rotation. Actually, he got some minutes when Walker was out and they had that comeback against the Hornets. I understand it's a comeback against the Hornets, but he did his job that game. But even that game was won not just by his minutes there, but their two-way center Carson Cooper who was just added to the team and played against the Hornets having not even had a practice with the team, giving them some minutes there. It's a clear position of need.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on Clint Capela as a backup center option
quotes.excerpt: Clint Capela, Clint Capela can be a backup of DeAndre Ayton
quotes.quote: Clint Capela, Clint Capela can be a backup of DeAndre Ayton.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Lakers' overachievement
quotes.excerpt: they are better than I thought they would be. I think, you know, they're better than Vegas thought
quotes.quote: They are better than I thought they would be. I think, you know, they're better than Vegas thought they would be. Vegas pegged them at 45 and a half. And you can, you can say whatever you want if you're a Lakers fan about how dare anybody not believe in their team. Vegas typically puts the Lakers with too many wins. They usually, they increase it a little bit because so many Lakers fans go to Vegas and want to bet on their team. And so it's hard to get a good over-under, a true over-under number on the sportsbooks because there's so many Lakers fans out there betting it. So the real number for Vegas might have been a little bit less than that. Okay, they're overachieving on that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Lakers' contract structures for trade purposes
quotes.excerpt: I sort of feel like everybody's contract on this team is like a year too long for trade purposes
quotes.quote: I sort of feel like everybody's contract on this team is like a year too long for trade purposes. I'm not talking about Luka or Austin or Kessler. I'm talking about like Jarred Vanderbilt, he's got the player option. Sexton has the player option.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on the Lakers' contract lengths
quotes.excerpt: Grimes is a four-year deal, Mama is a four-year deal, just when you and I'm just looking at like
quotes.quote: Grimes is a four-year deal, Mama is a four-year deal, just when you and I'm just looking at like the sizable contracts.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave McMenamin on Quentin Grimes' performance
quotes.excerpt: Grimes has had a heck of a week. We we should mention him too. Grimes had a heck of
quotes.quote: Grimes has had a heck of a week. We we should mention him too. Grimes had a heck of a week for them with Austin Reaves out.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on the possibility of a stretch big for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I do wonder if maybe a stretch big would be a better fit and we talked about Brook Lopez
quotes.quote: I do wonder if maybe a stretch big would be a better fit and we talked about Brook Lopez on the Monday pod, just as an example of a stretch big who is available.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Brook Lopez as a rotational big
quotes.excerpt: Brook Lopez would be a nice, I mean he's not an athlete, but Brook Lopez would be a nice
quotes.quote: Brook Lopez would be a nice, I mean he's not an athlete, but Brook Lopez would be a nice rotational big, I think, for most playoff teams.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on the stretch big trade market
quotes.excerpt: I say stretch bigs, simply because look, if you're going to come out of the West, you got to go
quotes.quote: I say stretch bigs, simply because look, if you're going to come out of the West, you got to go through San Antonio and I don't care who you run in pick-and-roll with, it's going to be a problem with Wemby, which you want to do is get him the hell away from the rim.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA Cup final should be held during All-Star weekend
quotes.excerpt: Don't have it at Hinkle Fieldhouse or Gainbridge Fieldhouse. How about you have it at the site for next season's All-Star weekend?
quotes.quote: Don't have it at Hinkle Fieldhouse or Gainbridge Fieldhouse. How about you have it at the site for next season's All-Star weekend? Like this year the NBA Cup will be in Miami, because next year's All-Star game is in Miami.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA Cup needs a more meaningful location
quotes.excerpt: If you want the league to show up for a small sample size game that ultimately means nothing, then at least make it a locale that means something.
quotes.quote: If you want the league to show up for a small sample size game that ultimately means nothing, then at least make it a locale that means something.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon admits to smoking layups due to age
quotes.excerpt: I smoke layups on a regular basis because I can't jump over a freaking credit card anymore.
quotes.quote: I smoke layups on a regular basis because I can't jump over a freaking credit card anymore. What do you want me to do? At the time I was in my late 40s, I'm 50 now. Stuff happens, you get old.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon's self-deprecating 'Angel Reese' nickname
quotes.excerpt: They call me Angel Reese now, the me-bounds. Smoke, smoke, smoke, smoke, I finally get one to fall.
quotes.quote: I get a lot of Moses buckets though. They call me Angel Reese now, the me-bounds. Smoke, smoke, smoke, smoke, I finally get one to fall.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Now joining us for the first time on the Hoop Collective, not new to ESPN but new to our NBA team at ESPN, from Philadelphia, where I believe he is from, is our new 76ers beat reporter, Kris Rhim. Kris, welcome to Friendsgiving.

text_blocks.speaker: Kris Rhim
text_blocks.text: Thank you for having me. I am from Philly, happy to be on, it's an honor.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon's first time meeting Kris Rhim
quotes.excerpt: Have you ever met Kris in person? No, I have not. So how are you friends?
quotes.quote: Have you ever met Kris in person? No, I have not. So how are you friends? I talk to him on the phone. I'm going to meet him, we'll be in Houston this weekend. It's the first time I'm going to meet the guy.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst's home setup with five TVs
quotes.excerpt: Windhorst has a setup, he's got like three TVs, but he really wants to have five.
quotes.quote: Windhorst has a setup, he's got like three TVs, but he really wants to have five. It's the one place when we remodeled the house, the one place that my wife was willing to cut corners on, you know, and really mind the cost.

quotes.speaker: Kris Rhim
quotes.summary_phrase: Kris Rhim's childhood fandom of Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: I was always a Kobe guy. I had a Kobe cake for like three straight birthdays.
quotes.quote: I was always a Kobe guy. I had a Kobe cake for like three straight birthdays. My camp counselor growing up, who now works for the Sixers, he once got me a basketball and said it was signed by Phil Jackson, and I believed him for a while. It wasn't, but I was a big Kobe guy. Once Kobe retired, I kind of just attached to players.

quotes.speaker: Kris Rhim
quotes.summary_phrase: Kris Rhim's perspective on the 76ers' process
quotes.excerpt: The Sixers were either just above mid, like average, to an embarrassment my whole life.
quotes.quote: The Sixers were either just above mid, like average, to an embarrassment my whole life. I'm a process baby. My friends turned to the Warriors and Steph Curry. Like they were giving away, I went to my high school this morning because they had career day and the person, his name Michael Horwitz, he sells Philly tickets. You couldn't give Sixers tickets away. When I was in high school, no one was going to these games. It was just like a joke, embarrassment of a team, so it was hard to be a fan to even be a fan of that team.

quotes.speaker: Kris Rhim
quotes.summary_phrase: Kris Rhim's high expectations for Michael Carter-Williams
quotes.excerpt: I was a big Michael Carter-Williams person. I thought he was going to be a perennial All-Star type of player.
quotes.quote: I was a big Michael Carter-Williams person. I thought he was going to be a perennial All-Star type of player. I used to always use him in 2K too. I had 2K leagues with my cousins and stuff and I'm on record like I thought he was going to be a perennial All-Star type of player.
